_comment: First-session tutorial. Each step shows a message anchored to a UI element, a control in an open panel or a world target (anchor_else is used while the anchor is not on screen). A step completes when the named game event fires (count times), when any of its done_when objectives (quest objective format) already holds - so doing it early, or from another screen, still counts - or when the player taps Next.

steps.text: Welcome to the claim, Foreman! The old company left this mine to rot. Let's bring it back to life.
Tap the glowing ore vein in the Topsoil Drift. Every tap is a swing of your pick - keep tapping!
Ore piles up at the shaft station. Tap LIFT to wind it up to the surface.
The conveyor carries it to the warehouse. Tap SELL to send the truck to market.
Money! Tap the Topsoil Drift to open it and hire a miner - miners work while you rest.
Upgrade Mining Operations in the Topsoil Drift to make every miner faster.
Goals pay big rewards. Open Goals and check them often!
Automate the lift and the trucks, dig deeper, and build a mining empire. Good luck!
